novel_features.name: Friendly doc-type search
novel_features.description: Search Logitech support docs by friendly type: spec sheet, manual, install guide, FAQ, download, warranty.
novel_features.rationale: Maps human doc-type words to Logitech's webcontent label taxonomy so users never memorize label strings.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents reach for this instead of guessing Zendesk label strings for spec sheets vs install guides.

novel_features.name: Offline full-text search
novel_features.description: Full-text search inside synced manuals and spec sheets from the local store.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local SQLite FTS5 index of article bodies that no single API call provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Search manuals offline, across a product family at once, without the Cloudflare-fronted site.

novel_features.name: Download resolver
novel_features.description: Resolve download01.logi.com file links in an article and fetch them (with --dry-run and local cache).
novel_features.rationale: File URLs live inside article HTML bodies, not a clean endpoint; requires parsing and caching.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Scriptable downloads of firmware/software/PDF manuals without clicking through the site.

novel_features.name: Spec comparison
novel_features.description: Side-by-side spec comparison between two products from synced spec sheets.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join across two products' spec rows that the API cannot do.
novel_features.why_it_matters: AV integrators compare dimensions and compatibility across products before quoting.

narrative.headline: Every Logitech manual, spec sheet, and install guide — searchable offline, agent-native, no browser.
narrative.value_prop: support.logi.com is a Zendesk portal with a clean JSON API hiding behind it. logitech-docs turns 33k+ reference documents into a greppable local index: find specs by product, pull install guides, and full-text search inside manuals without touching a browser.
narrative.auth_narrative: No authentication required. The support site and its Help Center API are public.

troubleshoots.fix: use the locale-free search form (articles search), not a locale-prefixed path

troubleshoots.symptom: empty article body in list output
troubleshoots.fix: list endpoints omit body; use articles get <id> for the full HTML

narrative.when_to_use: When an agent or technician needs a Logitech spec sheet, install guide, or manual without opening support.logi.com.
anti_triggers: Do not use for controlling Logitech devices or G HUB
Do not use for live support chat or warranty claims
Do not use for Logitech account management
